mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase above 8.0% signals labor market deterioration, triggering fiscal stimulus that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering policy responses that boost S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL increases >2.5% monthly) signals imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL increases by > 2.5% in the prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by >2.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained employment growth above 100,000 monthly additions (PAYEMS) strengthens consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production decline below 100.0 signals manufacturing contraction, prompting stimulus that generates positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent GDP contraction (GDPC1 decline) and housing market weakness (HOUST decline) indicate severe demand shock, triggering policy responses that boost S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines from prior quarter and HOUST declines from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 declines from prior quarter and HOUST declines from prior month.

mechanism_narrative: Robust industrial production above 105.0 supports supply chain stability, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days during strong supply regimes.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 105.0.
